integrity: A finite exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matching, with all face incidences checked, supplies the integral homotopy equivalence. A separate standard-library program independently enumerates faces and tests boundary ranks and the coloring.
scientific_limitations: One finite Paley graph; no assertion for other orders, all circulants, equivariant indices, or absolute bibliographic priority. Finite-field homology is corroborating rather than an integral homotopy proof.
title: The thirteen-vertex Paley neighborhood complex is a wedge of twenty-five two-spheres
